t = last_transition
b = t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); a = t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')

from collections import Counter
print(Counter((d[2],d[3]) for d in diffs))
# black piece top row cols now
cols = [c for c in range(64) if a[12][c]=='B']

print("timer rows:", ys[0], ys[-1], len(ys))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
